question: Which model gave the lowest conversion, whose kinetic parameters did it use, and what catalyst did it use?
expect: Model 5 (21%); Singh and Ali; K+ impregnated H3PW12O40.xH2O on graphene oxide (potassium-imbued phosphotungstic acid) (Table 1; sec. 2.3.5; Table 10)
rendered: Model 5 gave the lowest conversion. It used power law kinetics and the kinetic parameters were taken from the study by Singh et al. The catalyst used was potassium imbued phosphotungstic acid.
